overloads.semanticRole: The WP Insert break command inserts a new break of the breakType type in the targetObj according to the specified insertion mode and rangeUpdate parameters, and returns the text range of the break character In targetObj

constraints: rangeUpdate is only honored when targetObj is a range; it is ignored if targetObj is an element or document.
If rangeUpdate is omitted, the inserted break is included in the resulting range by default (equivalent to wk include in range).
